fusions.name: Plated Landing
fusions.desc: You leap to a target up to 6 tiles away and come down on it, dealing 16 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaving each [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Coil-Heeled Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks the target for 8 damage, knocking it back 2 tiles and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Sprung Plates
fusions.desc: A barrier absorbs the next 20 damage across up to 4 blows for 6 seconds and raises your armour by 8% while it holds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Loaded Leaf
fusions.desc: 12% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.
